title: Device job claim response
description: Response body for POST /api/device/jobs/claim (agent protocol, X-Bifrost-Key device auth). HTTP 204 with an empty body means no work is available. Frozen for epic #818 / M0.2 #828; breaking changes require an update to the epic before implementation changes.

script_content.description: UTF-8 PowerShell script body. Platform hard cap 256 KiB. Readable only through this fenced claim response; the device principal has no other script-body read path.

params.description: String-keyed JSON parameters passed to the job. Serialized size cap 32 KiB; the 256 KiB script cap applies to script_content alone.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock execution budget the agent must enforce locally (kill process tree on expiry, then report status=timeout).

max_output_bytes.description: Combined stdout/stderr byte cap. The agent truncates at this cap, sets truncated=true on the result, and never grows the spool past this size per job.

claim_token.description: Opaque fencing token minted at claim time. Required on POST logs and POST result for this job. Rotated on every (re)claim; a stale token is rejected with fence_violation.

claim_lease_seconds.description: The agent must report running or a terminal result within this lease. If it does not, the job stays reclaimable from claimed (never from running); a later claim mints a new claim_token.
